id: AT-ON-03 (a JSON array or object in the settings file)
note: 0.1.2 onboarding ON-5: settings::resolve reads a JSON array of strings or numbers for a list key (the `;` lists: protected_branches, prod_patterns, repo_roots, relaunch_allow, secret_extra_rules, deny_class_patterns, driver_skills) as its entries joined with `;`, with the note `<key>: a JSON list, read as its entries joined with ;`, so a protective list written as an array still adds its entries (it used to read as the text ARRAY(0x…) and add nothing). Any other array or object (one for a key that is not a list, or holding a non-scalar entry) is invalid: the default, with the note `<key>: not a single value, default used`. Notes never carry the value

steps.name: list keys as arrays: joined with ;, one note each; other keys' arrays and objects: the default with a note

stdout_has: "protected_branches: a JSON list, read as its entries joined with ;"
"prod_patterns: a JSON list, read as its entries joined with ;"
"watcher: not a single value, default used"
"deny_class_patterns: not a single value, default used"
"stall_min: not a single value, default used"

steps.name: status: a protected_branches array adds its entries to the shipped list

stdout_has: ^protected branches: the shipped list \+ 2 yours \(settings file\)$
^note: protected_branches: a JSON list, read as its entries joined with ;$
